parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.target_duration_seconds,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    s.narration_script,
    s.short_script,
    s.onscreen_text_json,
    coalesce(s.raw_response_json->'scene_guidance_json', '[]'::jsonb) as script_scene_guidance_json,
    d.director_json
  from content_items ci
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  join directors d on d.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status = 'directed'
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'storyboarding',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'directed'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.target_duration_seconds,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.narration_script,
  c.short_script,
  c.onscreen_text_json,
  c.script_scene_guidance_json,
  c.director_json
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

insert into storyboards (
  content_id,
  storyboard_json,
  cover_prompt,
  subtitle_lines_json,
  style_notes,
  render_manifest_seed_json
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.storyboard_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.cover_prompt_sql}}',
  '{{$json.subtitle_lines_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.style_notes_sql}}',
  '{{$json.render_manifest_seed_json_sql}}'::jsonb
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  storyboard_json = excluded.storyboard_json,
  cover_prompt = excluded.cover_prompt,
  subtitle_lines_json = excluded.subtitle_lines_json,
  style_notes = excluded.style_notes,
  render_manifest_seed_json = excluded.render_manifest_seed_json,
  generated_at = now()
returning content_id, generated_at;

update content_items
set status = 'storyboard_complete',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Storyboard SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Storyboard SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  'wf_storyboard_and_prompts',
  'success',
  now(),
  now(),
  0,
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Storyboard SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'scene_count', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Storyboard SQL Values"].json["scene_count_sql"]}},
    'cost', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Storyboard SQL Values"].json["cost_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
